android.desc:
Wire is secured with end-to-end encryption and makes life easier.
Get everything done in one app.

- Simple to use and beautifully designed
- A single tool to make small teams and complex organizations more productive
- Security and privacy at the core

Wire offers a free version for external business partners or friends and family.

Work securely, wherever you are

- Communicate and share information easily – call, chat, send pictures and files, audio and video messages – and be protected by the industry's most secure end-to-end encryption
- Stay in control of your data
- Increase privacy through self-deleting messages for sensitive information, device fingerprints, and guest links with passwords
- Eliminate risks with constant bitrate in calls

Stay connected and work productively

- Communicate with your teams through private or group conversations to bring the right people together
- Share and collaborate with files, documents, and links 
- Enjoy high-quality calls and video conferences
Invite partners, customers, and suppliers to collaborate through the unique guest rooms – perfect for one-time conversations
- Set up meetings quickly
- Use formatting options to write clear and structured messages
- Collaborate smoothly with the help of mentions, replies, and reactions
- Send a ping to get someone's attention
- Use QR codes to connect with people
- Share your location in a conversation
- Add conversations to a custom folder helps you organize your conversations by topics
- Archive conversations to keep your list clean
- Rely on full administrative controls

Get things done and enjoy it

- Customize the app to your needs: choose your favorite color, theme, and suitable text size
- Draw a sketch in any conversation 
- Send audio messages if you are on the go or too busy to type
- Use animated GIFs – text, select, share
- Use emojis to make your messages more fun
- History backup lets you take all the conversations, pictures, videos, and files when upgrading to a new phone
- Use Wire on up to 8 devices. Messages are separately end-to-end encrypted for each device. Your conversations are in sync across devices.
- Use up to 3 different Wire accounts on your device simultaneously — all without logging in and out

Wire is available on any device and operating system: iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux, and web browsers.
So your team can collaborate in the office, at home, or on the road.

wire.com

quotes.text:
I don't think anonymity is one of Signal's design goals-- privacy is.  But fwiw there is also Wire Messenger, which looks to me to be a kind of Signal w/o the phone # requirement (you can use an email address).  It claims to use the signal (axolotl double ratchet) algorithm for texts and video/audio uses webrtc https://wire.com/en/privacy/ with encryption and it's GPL'd.

Beyond that I haven't used it so can't vouch for it.  Anyone else got an opinion on this Swiss app?

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wire
quotes.story_title: Technology preview: Private contact discovery for Signal
